name: Human Hunter (CR 1/3)
body:
HUMAN HUNTER
CR 1/3

XP 135
Human hunter (tech bonded) 1
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +3; Senses Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex)
hp 10 (1d8+2)
Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +0

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee handaxe +1 (1d6+1/x3)
Ranged scrap rifle +3 (1d10/x3; misfire 1–5)
Tech-Bonded Hunter Spells Known (CL 1st; concentration +4)

1st (2/day)—enlarge person, repair light damage
0th (at will)—detect magic, light, mending, spark (DC 13)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 16, Wis 11, Cha 10
Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 14
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot
Skills Acrobatics +3, Craft (firearms) +7, Craft (mechanical) +7, Disable Device +7, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (engineering) +7, Knowledge (geography) +7, Perception +4, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +7, Survival +4
Languages Erahthi, Hymnas, Okantan, Terran
SQ aethertech empathy +1, construct companion (Kitscha)
Gear artisan tools (firearms), artisan tools (constructs), handaxe, mechanical components worth 30 au, scrap rifle (20 bullets), aetheric capacitor (9 au)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aethertech Empathy (Su)

The Human Hunter can tune into the vibrations of aetherite and understand its function as a standard action. This ability grants The Human Hunter hunter a +4 circumstance bonus on any Knowledge check pertaining to aethertech or constructs with the aether or aethership subtype.

This ability also functions as a Diplomacy check to improve the attitude of an unintelligent construct with the aether subtype. The Human Hunter rolls 1d20 and adds its hunter level and its Charisma modifier to determine the aethertech empathy result. Generally, influencing a construct in this way takes 1 minute but, as with influencing people, it might take more or less time.

The Human Hunter may attempt an aethertech empathy check on a construct with an Intelligence of 1 or 2, but takes a –4 penalty on such checks. For constructs with an Intelligence of 3 or higher use Diplomacy.

Construct Companion: The Human Hunter can use Knowledge (engineering) instead of Handle Animal for all purposes involving her construct companion, though he suffers a –5 penalty on these checks due to the construct companion’s unusual nature.

If the Human Hunter’s construct companion is destroyed, he may rebuild its companion with new components, requiring 50 au in raw materials per level and 24 uninterrupted hours of research and development in a suitable environment for crafting a construct.

Share Spells with Companion (Ex)

The Human Hunter may cast a spell with a target of “You” on his companion (as a spell with a range of touch) instead of on himself. The Human Hunter may cast spells on its animal companion even if the spells normally do not affect creatures of the companion’s type (construct). Spells cast in this way must come from a class that grants a construct companion. This ability does not allow the companion to share abilities that are not spells, even if they function like spells.

Construct Companion

XP 135
N Small construct (aether)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 24 (3d8+10)
Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +2
Immune construct traits

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +3 (1d4+1)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 17, Con —, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +2; CMB +2; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Acrobatics +7 (+15 to jump), Perception +8, Stealth +14; Racial Modifiers +4 to survival when tracking by scent
SQ advanced programming (4/day; farcaster component)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Construct Companion

The Human Hunter can repair damage to the companion by spending 2 hours on repairing damages and spending 10 au in mechanical components. At the end of this time The Human Hunter must succeed at a DC 20 Craft (mechanical) check. If successful he restores half of the companion’s total maximum hit points. If this check fails, The Human Hunter wastes 50% of the raw materials and repairs no damage.

The companion is destroyed if it reaches 0 hp. If the companion is destroyed, The Human Hunter may rebuild it with new components, requiring 50 au in raw materials per level and 24 uninterrupted hours of research and development in a suitable environment for crafting a construct.

Farcaster Component (Ex)

The Human Hunter’s companion can broadcast a short range message no longer than 1 minute as a standard action out to a range of 1 mile that can be picked up by any farcaster set to receive transmissions. This message can be delivered by any creature but must be transmitted immediately after being spoken.

Tricks: The companion knows the following tricks: attack, come, down, fetch, heel, sneak, stay.
